scope: Local continuity and evidence improvements; not release acceptance

improvements.name: context_dependency_evidence
improvements.behavior: Writing dependency candidates retain selected volume/arc and ambiguous line records with current hashes; accompanying world warnings are preserved. Saving a dependency does not resolve a state ambiguity.

improvements.name: minimum_known_spending
improvements.behavior: An unknown additional same-tick expense cannot cancel a shortfall already proved by known spending; required_is_minimum distinguishes the lower bound. Unknown income or baseline remains unverified.

unit_tests.counting: Successful test cases use addSuccess; failure/error/skip counts may include subtests

local_links.scope: Inline local Markdown file targets; remote URLs and heading anchors are not checked

independent_skill_exercises.method: Separate agent used relevant skills and real CLI without reading implementation, diff, tests or prior findings; temporary books removed.

checks: Two successive history publications followed by dependency re-declarations preserve current SHA, completeness and note.
External unpublished prose changes remain untouched and separate from the recorded chapter.
Missing history heads fail explicitly without lazy state creation.
Read-only queries preserve revision, SQL contents and database bytes.
history_boundary_review.method: Separate agent using isolated temporary books; no new files or tests needed.

limits: Executed on Intel macOS only; seven conditional skips are not passes.
No GitHub push, release, package publication or replacement of the real installed skills.
Dependency candidates still require actual selection and completion; a hash does not establish that an uncertain state is true.
No new token, capacity, migration or literary quality benchmark; prior validation records remain unchanged.
